title: nwl-2004-world-heavyweight
label: Maelstrom

won.source: The fed's own World Heavyweight Championship history page names Combat Episode 8 at the Nassau Coliseum as the match; the date is that of the website news item that the Episode 8 results are up. A roster thread of 25 April 2004 already calls him the first champion, before the final was written; the fed's own history page governs.

how: Won the title in a match against The Dragon, per a served promo's own recap.
note: No further World Heavyweight Championship reign is recorded in the held record; the fed's own last dated document (9 August 2004) records the promotion's closure with no title change reported.

title: nwl-2004-international
label: Pulsar

won.source: The fed's own International Championship history page names the Gridiron Gauntlet of Combat Episode 4 as the match; the card's line-up post is dated 19 March 2004 and the results page is undated.

how: Won the first Gridiron Gauntlet, ending in a steel cage against the Distributor of Pain, at Combat Episode 4, per the fed's own title history.
note: Pulsar defended the title on Combat Episode 5 (a count-out win over Krusher) and lost it to The American on Combat Episode 7.

lost.source: The fed's own International Championship history page names Combat Episode 7 at the Javits Center; the date is that of the owner's notice that the Episode 7 results are up.

title: nwl-2004-television
label: Jarod Poe

won.source: The fed's own Television Championship history page names the Rumble in the Jungle of Combat Episode 3 as the match; the card's line-up post is dated 3 March 2004 and the results page is undated.

how: Won the first Rumble in the Jungle at Combat Episode 3 by eliminating Shamrock Finnegan, the last other man in the ring after The American left it, per the fed's own title history.
note: Poe also defended the title on Combat Episodes 4 to 7 (the Episode 7 three-way is billed with no result held); the Underground line-up of May 2004 billed a title match against the Distributor of Pain, with no result held.

lost.source: The fed's own Television Championship history page names Combat Episode 8; the date is that of the website news item that the Episode 8 results are up.

title: nwl-2004-television
label: Distributor of Pain

won.source: The fed's own Television Championship history page names the match as Combat Episode 8 at the Nassau Coliseum; the date is that of the website news item that the results of Episode 8 are up.

how: Defeated Jarod Poe for the title at Combat Episode 8, per the fed's own title history.
note: The held Underground line-up of May 2004 billed a title match between the two men; no later change is recorded and the fed closed on 1 August 2004.

title: nwl-2004-international
label: The American

won.source: The fed's own International Championship history page names the match as Combat Episode 7 at the Javits Center; the date is that of the owner's notice that the results of Episode 7 are up.

how: Defeated Pulsar for the title at Combat Episode 7 after Lars Magellan and Shamrock Finnegan distracted Pulsar, per the fed's own title history.
note: The line-up of Combat Episode 9 lists him as champion defending against Pulsar; no result is held.
